blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. Every Monday we plan the week. We are going to send two ships, check the stock and meet a new supplier.

We use "going to" for decisions made before the moment of speaking. It shows a plan we already have. It is future, but the choice is not new — we made it before.

Today you learn 5 important words and practise the future with going to. We start slow. You can do it!

items.q: When do they plan the week?
items.why: "Every Monday we plan the week."

items.q: What are they going to do this week?
options: Send two ships, check the stock and meet a new supplier
items.why: "We are going to send two ships, check the stock and meet a new supplier."

items.q: What does "going to" show?
options: A thing that is happening now
A thing that will never happen
A plan decided before the moment of speaking
items.why: "'Going to' shows decisions made before the moment of speaking."

items.q: The words "We start slow" suggest that…
options: the lesson is friendly and made for beginners
the lesson is very hard and only for experts
there is no time to learn
items.why: Inferência: "We start slow. You can do it!" mostra um tom de apoio para iniciantes.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: planning happens only once a year
a plan is a decision you make before you act
items.why: Inferência: o texto liga planos a decisões feitas antes de agir ("going to").

blocks.instruction: Ouça a pessoa que lidera a reunião semanal de planejamento. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning, team. It is Monday, so let's plan the week together. It is going to be a busy week, but a good one.

First, our goal is simple. We are going to ship two orders and keep every client happy. That is the number one goal for this week. Please write it down.

On Tuesday, we are going to have a short meeting with the new supplier. Ana is going to send the report before that meeting, so we all have the numbers. Come with your questions.

Now, please look at the deadline. The report is due on Wednesday. That is not a lot of time, so start today, not tomorrow. Small steps every day are better than one big rush.

I am not going to send you ten emails this week. I trust you. If the plan changes, we are going to talk and fix it together. A plan can change — that is normal, and that is fine.

So, our goal is clear, our meeting is on Tuesday, and our deadline is Wednesday. Let's have a great week. You can do it!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is the number one goal this week?
options: To ship two orders and keep clients happy
items.why: "We are going to ship two orders and keep every client happy. That is the number one goal."

items.q: When is the meeting with the new supplier?
items.why: "On Tuesday, we are going to have a short meeting with the new supplier."

items.q: When is the report due?
items.why: "The report is due on Wednesday."

items.q: Why does the leader say "start today, not tomorrow"?
options: Because the office is closed tomorrow
Because the deadline is close and time is short
Because the report is already done
items.why: Inferência: o prazo é quarta-feira e há pouco tempo, por isso é melhor começar já.

items.q: How would you best describe the leader's tone?
items.why: Inferência: "I trust you" e "You can do it!" mostram um tom calmo e de apoio.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We have a clear plan for the week." A plan is…
options: an idea of what you are going to do
items.why: Plan = plano: o que você pretende fazer.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We are going to have a short ___ with the team on Tuesday."
items.why: Meeting = reunião, quando as pessoas se encontram para conversar.

items.q: "Please send me the report today." A report is…
options: a document that shows information or results
items.why: Report = relatório: um documento com informações ou resultados.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Our ___ this week is to ship two orders."
items.why: Goal = meta: o resultado que queremos alcançar.

items.q: "The deadline is Wednesday." A deadline is…
options: the first day of the plan
the last day to finish something
items.why: Deadline = prazo: o último dia para terminar algo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples de trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Let's kick off the meeting." To kick off means to…
items.why: Kick off = começar (uma reunião, um projeto).

items.q: "We are going to wrap up at five." To wrap up means to…
items.why: Wrap up = terminar, fechar.

items.q: "I am going to follow up with the supplier tomorrow." To follow up means to…
options: check again and continue the contact
items.why: Follow up = dar seguimento, retomar o contato depois.

items.q: "The boss will sign off on the plan." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "We are going to roll out the new plan next week." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = colocar em prática, lançar.
